name: Request and cancel a ride
description: A passenger validates the route, requests a ride, cancels it and sees the persisted cancelled record.
steps: Click Install demo. Verify Android and iPhone instructions and the warning that real rides and payments are not provided. Close installation help.
Start a new demo using the sidebar menu.
Set pickup and destination both to Accra Mall. Verify Request is disabled and a validation message appears.
Set destination to Osu Oxford Street, select DropIn Go, then request a ride.
Verify a current ride with a demo driver and a fare appears.
Cancel ride, choose Keep ride, then cancel again and Confirm cancellation.
Open My rides from the sidebar and refresh the browser.
expected: The demo ride remains visible as Ride cancelled with its quoted fare, and no active ride remains.

name: Complete a trip and record driver earnings
covers: driver acceptance and ordered trip states
description: A booked ride progresses through the driver workflow and yields a durable receipt, earnings and rating.
steps: Start a new demo.
In Passenger book DropIn Go from Accra Mall to Osu Oxford Street.
Switch to Driver and select Kwame Mensah.
Click Accept ride, Arrived at pickup, Start trip and Complete trip in order.
Open Earnings and verify a completed trip and nonzero net demo earnings; download its receipt.
Switch to Passenger and rate the completed ride 5 stars.
Switch to Admin and verify Overview shows one completed ride and its gross fare.
Open Ride management and export demo rides. Refresh the browser.
expected: The completed ride persists, earnings equal 85% of the fare, overview records the completed fare, receipt and CSV download, and returning to Passenger no longer shows the rating prompt.

name: Manage availability and fare settings
description: Offline availability yields an unassigned request which can be redispatched after pricing settings are saved.
steps: Start a new demo.
Switch to Admin, open Drivers & applicants and click Online for Kwame Mensah to set him Offline.
Open Fare settings, change base fare to 10 and commission to 20, then save.
Switch to Passenger and request DropIn Go from Accra Mall to Osu Oxford Street.
Verify Finding a driver is visible. Note the quoted fare.
Switch to Admin, set Kwame Mensah back Online and change base fare to 12.
Open Ride management and click Find driver again.
Refresh the browser and review the trip record.
expected: The existing quoted fare is retained, the ride becomes Waiting for driver with Kwame assigned, and the updated base fare 12 and commission 20 persist in Fare settings.

name: Submit and review driver applications
description: A sample driver is approved into the offline roster and a second application can be rejected.
steps: Start a new demo.
In Passenger select Tamale from Service city and verify Tamale places are available.
Open Drive with DropIn from the sidebar. Try submitting an empty application and verify required fields block it.
Submit sample name Demo Driver, vehicle Toyota Corolla, city Tamale.
Switch to Admin, open Drivers & applicants, approve Demo Driver.
Switch to Passenger, submit sample name Reject Driver, vehicle Kia Picanto, city Accra.
Switch to Admin, reject Reject Driver. Refresh.
Open Help using Service status if visible, or switch to Passenger and open the mobile sidebar then return to the desktop if necessary; verify live services are shown as setup required.
expected: Demo Driver is an approved offline driver in Tamale, Reject Driver remains rejected and not in the roster, and live Firebase, GPS, MoMo and WhatsApp are identified as not connected.

name: Surface backend write failures without phantom rides
description: A failed booking is displayed as an error without a false success or active trip.

body_json.error: Booking is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.

steps: Start a new demo.
Request DropIn Go from Accra Mall to Osu Oxford Street.
Verify a visible booking error, then open My rides.
Open Help and service status, verify demo and unconfigured live services, then close it.
Start a new demo and open My rides.
expected: An error message is visible after booking failure, no ride is present in history, and a new demo begins with no trip records.
